patterns.condition: LONG with ADX > 35 AND RSI between 50-70 AND MACD >= 0
patterns.recommendation: This is the strongest long setup; prioritize entries matching all three criteria for highest probability trades.
Avoid LONG trades during strongly positive sentiment (>0.15); market tends to pullback after sentiment extremes.
Avoid SHORT trades entirely; insufficient edge and poor win rate; focus exclusively on LONG directional bias.

patterns.condition: LONG with low ADX (< 20) AND RSI 49-65

strongest_long_setup: LONG when ADX > 35, RSI 50-70, MACD >= 0, DI+ > DI- by at least 10 points, and SENTIMENT between -0.35 and +0.15. This setup achieved 67% win rate (4W-2L).
strongest_short_setup: SHORT trades show insufficient edge with only 13% win rate (1W-7L). Recommend avoiding SHORT direction entirely and focusing capital on high-conviction LONG setups only.
summary: The brain demonstrates a strong LONG bias with 20W-19L on long trades vs 1W-7L on shorts, indicating directional strength only works in uptrend regime. The highest-probability setup requires confluence of strong trend (ADX > 35), momentum confirmation (RSI 50-70, MACD >= 0), and neutral-to-negative sentiment bias—avoid chasing during sentiment extremes above +0.15. Never initiate trades in low-ADX (<20) environments regardless of other signals.
